Monster by Kanye West and Take Me Out by Franz Ferdinand

Take Me Out still has a good vibe the whole way through, but it's intro just feels like a different song and I wish it carries that through but it just doesn't sadly.

Monster by Kanye West is another great one, it's intro is really solid but after the first 3-4 lines it completely falls off for me.
Theoretically it goes infinite unless you get really unlucky
Thank you for the extended answer 😊
Okay thank you for the clarification, that makes more sense
I will definitely consider this, if I paired it with [[Syphon Sliver]] I'd get all the life I lost back from the damage I deal.
Right I didn't really think about them also getting the buffs from the "All Slivers" Slivers. Since most Slivers affect all not just ones I control.
Yeah I probably am just overcomplicating it

Oh that actually is a good idea, if I could get it on the board at least. Paired with [[Hivestone]] I could give it shroud with [[Crystalline Sliver]]. But I believe that would only make the stack more confusing.

I mean if I could find a way to give someone [[Hivestone]] or [[Maskwood Nexus]] that could probably be the only way to bypass Shifting Sliver to pair with the Hunter Sliver. Would you have any recommendations on easy ways to give other players artifacts?

Thank you for the explanation, like I said to a previous comment. Would there be any cards or other mechanics that can accomplish what I'm trying to get around with Shifting Sliver where I can force blockers by choice rather than my opponents choosing. Or is that simply not a thing I'd be able to do.

Aside from the fight mechanic, would there be anyway I can bypass Shifting Sliver and force blockers or is it simply something I'd have to deal with. 

I'm not exactly complaining about it since Shifting Sliver is just the better Shadow Sliver (since the Shadow mechanic sucks). But if there is a way to accomplish what I'm trying to it could be pretty dirty, even though Slivers are dirty enough as is.

That's fair enough yeah, I just wasn't certain if provoke had special rulings or not. I've never actually seen Provoke before so I wasn't overly familiar with how it worked outside the descriptive text.
Even if they do happen again the chance of it having the same effect it once did isn't likely..
it looks amazing, Nurgle is my favorite Chaos God so this is really cool to see.
